descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

SST Product Architect

__

Your role and responsibilities

We are seeking an enthusiastic and experienced Senior Power Electronics Testing and Laboratory Specialist to be part of the expansion of our business with a novel solid state transformer technology for datacenter applications. In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of the ELDS R&D center of excellence team for Solid State Transformer in charge of the design and development of the future Solid State Transformer products family with first focus on Data Center application requirements. In this context, and as part of the R&D SST development team, the Senior Testing and Laboratory Specialist will have special focus on the implementation and execution of the validation, qualification and certification testing activities and protocols for components, sub-systems and systems within the internal and external R&D and Production Lab facilities for the new ABB SST offering. The location for this position is Baden-Daettwil in Switzerland, with relocation possibilities to other production locations.

You will be mainly responsible for:

  • Member of the SST for Data Center R&D team, leading the testing activities in R&D labs for the Validation, Qualification and Certification of the SST components, sub-systems and systems using the R&D Prototypes and Tests Units in the existing and new internal testing setups and areas and in external facilities. This includes planning, practical implementation and execution, analysis and documentation activities of SST tests, with close interaction with program manager, product architect, other R&D engineers, testing and laboratory specialists and technicians.

  • Responsible for the definition of the SST dedicated lab test processes and protocols, infrastructure, areas and equipment, with active interaction and collaboration with the different stakeholders in the different locations involved (CH, CZ, IT, US), including the Lab Infrastructure and the Health Safety and Environment (HSE) teams.

  • Close support and collaboration with the productization and factory teams for the SST production testing activities, involving the definition of the test specifications, the training of testing engineers, test data and results documentation, adaptation of tests protocols, etc.

  • Contribution to the maintenance and further development of the key Power Electronics Technologies Expertise and Know-How of the SST for Datacenters R&D team in testing, validation and certification.

You will be part of advanced R&D activities in the field of power electronics for the ABB SST for Datacenter Products, in close cooperation with a highly qualified senior team of R&D engineers and scientists in a global and multicultural setup.

• Qualifications for the role

  • University, University of Applied Sciences Bachelor or Master degree, or Equivalent Experience in the field of electrical engineering with focus on Power Electronics testing, validation, qualification and certification.

  • Solid background experience and high interest on practical R&D experimentation, testing and validation in Medium Voltage and High Power lab environment for the introduction to the market of Power Electronics converter new products and functionalities. Expertise in solutions and components validation, productization and certification in MV environment is desired.

  • Know-how and expertise in test systems, equipment and infrastructure related to the validation and qualification of power electronics components and sub-systems testing, including protocols for safety, quality, reliability, and certification.

  • Interest in applied research and development, self-organized, motivated person, that likes to work in a highly qualified research and development team composed of experts in different domains and global locations.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English. German is a plus.

  • Availability to travel sporadically.

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). The recruiting process is being led by Ece Özen, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

In questo contesto, e nell'ambito del team di sviluppo R&D SST, il Senior Testing and Laboratory Specialist avrà particolare attenzione all'implementazione e all'esecuzione delle attività di validazione, qualificazione e certificazione di test e protocolli per componenti, sottosistemi e sistemi all'interno delle strutture R&D e Production Lab interne ed esterne per la nuova offerta ABB SST. descriptionByLocale.de:
At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, das zu steuern, was die Welt beherrscht.

Diese Position berichtet an:

SST Product Architect

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

< Wir suchen einen enthusiastischen und erfahrenen Senior Power Electronics Testing und Laborspezialisten, der Teil der Erweiterung unseres Geschäfts mit einer neuartigen Festkörpertransformatortechnologie für Rechenzentrumsanwendungen ist. In dieser Funktion haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Teil des ELDS F&E-Kompetenzzentrums für Solid State Transformer zu sein, das für das Design und die Entwicklung der zukünftigen Solid State Transformer-Produktfamilie mit dem ersten Schwerpunkt auf den Anforderungen der Data Center-Anwendung verantwortlich ist. In diesem Zusammenhang und als Teil des F&E-SST-Entwicklungsteams wird sich der Senior Testing and Laboratory Specialist besonders auf die Implementierung und Durchführung der Validierungs-, Qualifizierungs- und Zertifizierungstestaktivitäten und -protokolle für Komponenten, Subsysteme und Systeme innerhalb der internen und externen F&E- und Produktionslabors für das neue ABB SST-Angebot konzentrieren. Standort für diese Position ist Baden-Daettwil in der Schweiz mit Verlagerungsmöglichkeiten an andere Produktionsstandorte.

Sie sind hauptverantwortlich für:

  • Mitglied des SST for Data Center R&D-Teams, das die Testaktivitäten in R&D-Labors für die Validierung, Qualifizierung und Zertifizierung der SST-Komponenten, Subsysteme und Systeme mit den R&D-Prototypen und Testeinheiten in den bestehenden und neuen internen Testaufbauten und -bereichen sowie in externen Einrichtungen leitet. Dies umfasst die Planung, praktische Durchführung und Durchführung, Analyse und Dokumentation von SST-Tests in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Programmmanager, Produktarchitekten, anderen F & E-Ingenieuren, Test- und Laborspezialisten und Technikern.

  • Verantwortlich für die Definition der SST-spezifischen Labortestprozesse und -protokolle, Infrastruktur, Bereiche und Ausrüstung, mit aktiver Interaktion und Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen Interessengruppen an den verschiedenen beteiligten Standorten (CH, CZ, IT, USA), einschließlich der Laborinfrastruktur und der Teams für Gesundheitssicherheit und Umwelt (HSE).

  • Enge Unterstützung und Zusammenarbeit mit den Produkt- und Werksteams für die SST-Produktionstestaktivitäten, einschließlich der Definition der Testspezifikationen, der Schulung von Testingenieuren, der Testdaten- und Ergebnisdokumentation, der Anpassung von Testprotokollen usw.

  • Beitrag zur Wartung und Weiterentwicklung der wichtigsten Power Electronics Technologies Expertise und Know-How des SST for Datacenters F&E-Teams in Test, Validierung und Zertifizierung.

Sie werden Teil der fortgeschrittenen F & E-Aktivitäten im Bereich Leistungselektronik für das ABB SST für Datacenter-Produkte sein, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem hochqualifizierten Senior-Team von F & E-Ingenieuren und Wissenschaftlern in einem globalen und multikulturellen Setup. • Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Universität, Fachhochschule Bachelor oder Master oder gleichwertige Erfahrung im Bereich der Elektrotechnik mit Schwerpunkt auf Prüfung, Validierung, Qualifizierung und Zertifizierung von Leistungselektronik.

  • Solide Hintergrunderfahrung und großes Interesse an praktischen F & E-Experimenten, Tests und Validierungen in Mittelspannungs- und Hochleistungslaborumgebungen für die Einführung neuer Produkte und Funktionen von Power Electronics-Konvertern auf den Markt. Expertise in Lösungen und Komponenten Validierung, Produktisierung und Zertifizierung in MV-Umgebung ist erwünscht.

  • Know-how und Expertise in Testsystemen, Ausrüstung und Infrastruktur im Zusammenhang mit der Validierung und Qualifizierung von Leistungselektronikkomponenten und Subsystemprüfung, einschließlich Protokolle für Sicherheit, Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und Zertifizierung.

  • Interesse an angewandter Forschung und Entwicklung, selbstorganisierte, motivierte Person, die gerne in einem hochqualifizierten Forschungs- und Entwicklungsteam arbeitet, das sich aus Experten in verschiedenen Bereichen und globalen Standorten zusammensetzt.

  • Fluency in schriftlichem und gesprochenem Englisch. Deutsch ist ein Plus.

  • Verfügbarkeit für sporadische Reisen.

Mehr über uns

Die ABB-Division Distribution Solutions ermöglicht die effiziente und zuverlässige Verteilung, den Schutz und die Steuerung von Strom durch Verbesserung der Stromqualität bei gleichzeitiger Stärkung der Widerstandsfähigkeit des Netzes. Die Division bietet segmentspezifische Produkte und Lösungen, die hauptsächlich Versorgungsunternehmen, Industrie- und Infrastruktursegmente bedienen und oft die erforderliche Mittelspannungsverbindung zwischen Hochspannungsübertragungssystemen und Niederspannungsnutzern bieten. Mit ABB AbilityTM-fähigen vernetzten Lösungen im Kern umfasst das Angebot Mittelspannungs-luft- und gasisolierte Schaltanlagen (1 bis 66 Kilovolt), Innen- und Außenleistungsschalter, Wiederverschlüsse, Sicherungen, Schütze, Relais, Messwandler, Sensoren, Motorsteuerzentralen sowie Niederspannungsschaltanlagen.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung (auf Englisch eingereichte Dokumente werden geschätzt). Den Recruiting-Prozess leitet Ece Özen, Talent Partner bei ABB Switzerland Ltd. Wenn Sie mehr über ABB erfahren möchten, werfen Sie einen Blick auf unsere Website www.abb.com.


Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Bereit, etwas zu bewirken?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Cette position se rapporte à:

SST Product Architect

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Senior Power Electronics Testing and Laboratory Specialist pour participer à l'expansion de notre entreprise avec une nouvelle technologie de transformateur d'état solide pour les applications de datacenter. Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion de faire partie de l'équipe ELDS R&D d'excellence pour Solid State Transformer en charge de la conception et du développement de la future famille de produits Solid State Transformer avec un premier accent sur les exigences d'application Data Center. Dans ce contexte, et dans le cadre de l'équipe de développement des SST en R-D, le spécialiste principal des essais et des laboratoires se concentrera tout particulièrement sur la mise en oeuvre et l'exécution des activités et des protocoles de validation, de qualification et de certification des composants, sous-systèmes et systèmes des installations internes et externes de R-D et de laboratoire de production pour la nouvelle offre de SST ABB. Vous serez principalement responsable :

  • Membre de l'équipe de R-D du Centre de données, qui dirigera les activités d'essai dans les laboratoires de R-D pour la validation, la qualification et la certification des composants, sous-systèmes et systèmes de S-T à l'aide des prototypes et des unités d'essai de R-D dans les installations et zones d'essai internes existantes et nouvelles et dans les installations externes. Cela comprend la planification, la mise en oeuvre et l'exécution pratiques, l'analyse et la documentation des essais de TSS, avec une interaction étroite avec le gestionnaire de programme, l'architecte de produits, d'autres ingénieurs en R-D, des spécialistes en laboratoire et des techniciens. Responsable de la définition des processus et protocoles d'essais en laboratoire, de l'infrastructure, des domaines et de l'équipement, avec interaction active et collaboration avec les différents intervenants des différents endroits concernés (CH, CZ, IT, É.-U.), y compris l'infrastructure du laboratoire et les équipes de la sécurité et de l'environnement de la santé.

  • Soutien et collaboration étroits avec les équipes de production et d'usine pour les activités d'essais de production de SST, y compris la définition des spécifications d'essai, la formation des ingénieurs d'essais, la documentation sur les données et les résultats d'essais, l'adaptation des protocoles d'essais, etc.

  • Contribution à la maintenance et au développement de l'expertise clé en technologies de l'électronique de puissance et à la connaissance de l'équipe de R-D des centres de données pour les essais, la validation et la certification.

Vous participerez à des activités de R-D avancées dans le domaine de l'électronique de puissance pour l'ABB SST for Datacenter Products, en étroite collaboration avec une équipe d'ingénieurs et de scientifiques hautement qualifiés en R-D dans une configuration globale et multiculturelle.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Université, Université des sciences appliquées Baccalauréat ou maîtrise, ou expérience équivalente dans le domaine du génie électrique, en mettant l'accent sur l'essai de l'électronique de puissance, la validation, la qualification et la certification.

  • Expérience de base solide et grand intérêt pour l'expérimentation pratique de R-D, les essais et la validation dans l'environnement de laboratoire à moyenne tension et haute puissance pour l'introduction au marché de convertisseurs de nouveaux produits et fonctionnalités Power Electronics. Une expertise en matière de validation, de production et de certification de solutions et de composants dans l'environnement MV est souhaitée.

  • Savoir-faire et expertise en matière de systèmes d'essai, d'équipement et d'infrastructure liés à la validation et à la qualification des composants et sous-systèmes électroniques de puissance, y compris les protocoles de sécurité, de qualité, de fiabilité et de certification.

  • Intérêt pour la recherche appliquée et le développement, personne auto-organisée et motivée, qui aime travailler dans une équipe de recherche et de développement hautement qualifiée composée d'experts dans différents domaines et à l'échelle mondiale.

  • L'allemand est un plus.

  • Disponibilité de voyager sporadiquement.

Plus sur nous

La Division des solutions de distribution d'ABB facilite la distribution, la protection et le contrôle efficaces et fiables de l'énergie en améliorant la qualité de l'énergie électrique tout en renforçant la résilience du réseau. La Division offre des produits et des solutions spécifiques à certains segments qui servent en grande partie les secteurs des services publics, de l ' industrie et de l ' infrastructure, fournissant souvent le lien nécessaire entre les systèmes de transmission à haute tension et les utilisateurs à faible tension. Avec les solutions connectées ABB CapabilityTM à son cœur, l'offre comprend des commutateurs à moyenne tension à air et à gaz (1 à 66 kilovolts), des disjoncteurs intérieurs et extérieurs, des refermeurs, des fusibles, des contacteurs, des relais, des transformateurs d'instruments, des capteurs, des centres de commande de moteurs, ainsi que des commutateurs à basse tension.

Nous avons hâte de recevoir votre demande (les documents présentés en anglais sont appréciés). Le processus de recrutement est dirigé par Ece Özen, Talent Partner chez ABB Switzerland Ltd. Si vous voulez en savoir plus sur ABB, consultez notre site Web www.abb.com.


Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous horizons et expériences.

Prêt à avoir un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions dans le monde entier.

At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Order Management Specialist

__

In this role, you have the opportunity to provide customer support. You are a problem solver for all inquiries, including technical support as well as assistance with orders, delivery performance questions, and payments—to achieve the targeted goals regarding service quality, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. You implement the customer service strategy daily to increase operational excellence and customer satisfaction in the sales process. Additionally, you bring in your expertise by supporting the achievement of defined goals, monitoring progress, and implementing improvement measures as needed. In your role, you serve as an interface with internal and external partners to ensure a smooth flow of order processing.

The working model is: #LI-hybrid

This role contributes to the Local Product Group Smart Buildings in the Switzerland region. Key contacts are internal and external customers, sales, logistics, product marketing, procurement, planning, and quality assurance.

You will be part of a young, dedicated, experienced, and customer-focused team in which you can develop and actively contribute to continuous improvement.

Your main responsibilities will be:

-
Close collaboration with internal and external customers via meetings, email, and Teams.

-
Processing orders, complaints, and returns through coordination with sales, product marketing, logistics, quality, planning, scheduling, and other internal teams to ensure accurate and timely delivery of products to customers.

-
Serving as the first point of contact for customer inquiries and orders as well as ensuring the resolution of customer problems.

-
Support in pre-sales or after-sales service by solving customer problems and ensuring effective and efficient customer communication using specific commercial communication tools.

What we’re looking for:

-
You have commercial training/education, ideally with further training in foreign trade or at a higher vocational education level (e.g., HF).

-
At least 1 year of professional experience, preferably in sales support, order processing, or comparable areas.

-
You are proficient in SAP Sales & Distribution, MS Office, and customer communication tools.

-
You are a team player with a solution-oriented and independent work style, strong communication skills, and a positive attitude towards change.

-
You have a good understanding of logistics processes.

-
You communicate confidently in German and English.

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings enables the optimization of energy efficiency, security, protection, and comfort for all types of buildings—both for new construction and retrofit solutions. The division offers integrated digital technologies for controlling HVAC, lighting, blinds, and security as well as solutions for energy distribution, including DIN rail products, enclosures, emergency lighting, and industrial connectors and conventional installation materials. The division's highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve the worldwide increasing demand from real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meet social and environmental requirements, and support even the most complex CO₂ reduction strategies of customers.

The recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Partner Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__


Your role and responsibilities

As a Commissioning Engineer, you will oversee commissioning in projects with low to medium complexity, and guide Associate Commissioning Engineers and coordinating work. You will ensure that commissioning activities are completed efficiently and cost-effectively, in accordance with specifications, standards, and safety requirements.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Energy Industries division in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Commissioning and servicing of Automatic Voltage Regulators and Static Excitation Systems in power plants of all types and sizes, including voltage regulators in power plant installations with capacities up to 1000 MW. Conduct remote services and support to enhance the solutions and additionally perform network stability studies with a focus on power plant stabilities and grid code compliance.

  • Assist in continuous improvement of project design, participate in project review meetings, and provide input on service activities. Help create proposals for engineering projects or programs and assist Contract Managers in issuing claims.

  • Create work plans and cost estimates for various tasks, conduct risk and opportunity assessments during commissioning, and report potential risks and resolutions. Identify and recommend solutions to meet business and customer needs and provide relevant information accordingly.

  • Provide information to contractors and colleagues and give feedback to the organization to apply lessons learned. Apply and improve processes and tools through automation and digitalization to ensure effective project delivery.

• Qualifications for the role

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in either commissioning for the power generation industry or as power system engineer responsible for power system studies.

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach and written and spoken communication skills in English (German advance).

  • Excitement and interest for digitalization of remote service concepts.

  • In-depth knowledge of power systems simulation tools (PowerFactory and PSS\E), synchronous machines and excitation systems as well as profound understanding of control theory, data analysis and information technology.

  • Eagerness to engage directly with clients and teams worldwide—travel commitment up to 60%.

More about us

ABB Energy Industries is enabling safe, smart and sustainable projects and operations for businesses across the oil, gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation and water sectors. Driving integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify industry we connect our people and technology to help our customers adapt and succeed.

The recruiting process is being led by Pedro Labián, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

This position reports to:
Portfolio Manager – Business Line Medium Voltage Drives

__

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion

In this role, you will manage the marketing of ABB’s training service offerings for Medium Voltage Drives, targeting defined market segments and ensuring alignment with market needs and business line strategy. You will be accountable for the full lifecycle of the offering portfolio, from development and launch to go-to-market, maintenance, pricing, and profitability.

You will own the long-term profitable growth of the training services portfolio, ensuring offerings are scalable, competitive, and deliver customer value. By collaborating across functions and regions, you will support business results and continuously optimize performance, enabling high-quality service execution and capability development worldwide.

Location

This role is open globally, with preferred locations in Poland, Switzerland, Finland, China, India, and the United States. The work model is hybrid #LI-hybrid.

Key
• Responsibilities

- Own and manage the global training services portfolio for Medium Voltage Drives, ensuring clear service definitions and scalability.

- Drive full lifecycle management of training services (concept, development, launch, scaling, phase‑out).

- Define training service roadmap aligned with business line strategy and product lifecycle evolution.

- Collaborate with sales, service, and regional teams to identify skill gaps and position training as part of service solutions.

- Translate installed base and modernization needs into targeted training offerings that improve execution and win rates.

- Enable field teams and customers through structured, role-based training paths and service offerings.

- Track performance (revenue, utilization, customer satisfaction) and drive continuous improvement and profitability.

- Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory standards across global training services

• Qualifications

- Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Industrial Management, or related field.

- Several years of experience in training services, adult education, or service product management.

- Strong understanding of industrial service environments and capability development.

- Proven experience working in global, cross-functional and matrix organizations.

- Commercial mindset with ability to manage service portfolios and lifecycle.

- Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

- Ability to translate technical/operational needs into scalable service offerings.

- Customer- and safety-oriented, with proactive and collaborative approach.

We empower you to take the lead, share bold ideas, and shape real outcomes. You’ll grow through hands-on experience, mentorship, and learning that fits your goals. Here, your work doesn’t just matter, it moves things forward.

Um den Industrien der Welt zu helfen, schlanker und sauberer zu werden, liefern wir motorgetriebene Lösungen für eine Vielzahl von Anwendungen in allen Industriesegmenten. Aufbauend auf über 140 Jahren Erfahrung im Bereich Elektroantriebe lernen und verbessern unsere mehr als 22.000 Mitarbeiter in 100 Ländern jeden Tag. go.abb/motion In dieser Funktion verwalten Sie die Vermarktung der ABB-Schulungsangebote für Mittelspannungsantriebe, zielen auf definierte Marktsegmente ab und gewährleisten die Ausrichtung auf die Marktbedürfnisse und die Geschäftsstrategie. Durch die Zusammenarbeit über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg unterstützen Sie die Geschäftsergebnisse und optimieren kontinuierlich die Leistung, was eine qualitativ hochwertige Serviceausführung und die Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten weltweit ermöglicht. Standort Diese Rolle ist weltweit offen, mit bevorzugten Standorten in Polen, der Schweiz, Finnland, China, Indien und den Vereinigten Staaten. Das Arbeitsmodell ist hybrid #LI-hybrid. Schlüssel
• Verantwortlichkeiten - Besitzen und verwalten Sie das globale Trainingsportfolio für Mittelspannungsantriebe, um klare Servicedefinitionen und Skalierbarkeit zu gewährleisten. - Förderung des vollständigen Lifecycle-Managements von Schulungsdienstleistungen (Konzept, Entwicklung, Einführung, Skalierung, Auslauf). - Definieren Sie eine Roadmap für Schulungsdienste, die auf die Geschäftsstrategie und die Entwicklung des Produktlebenszyklus ausgerichtet ist. - Zusammenarbeit mit Vertriebs-, Service- und Regionalteams, um Qualifikationslücken und Positionsschulungen als Teil von Servicelösungen zu identifizieren. Übersetzen Sie installierte Basis- und Modernisierungsanforderungen in gezielte Schulungsangebote, die die Ausführung und Gewinnraten verbessern. - Ermöglichen Sie Außendienstteams und Kunden durch strukturierte, rollenbasierte Schulungspfade und Serviceangebote. - Verfolgen Sie die Leistung (Umsatz, Auslastung, Kundenzufriedenheit) und fördern Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Rentabilität. - Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Regulierungsstandards für globale Schulungsdienste
• Qualifikationen - Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft, Industriemanagement oder verwandten Bereichen. - Mehrjährige Erfahrung in den Bereichen Ausbildung, Erwachsenenbildung oder Serviceproduktmanagement. - Starkes Verständnis von industriellen Serviceumgebungen und Fähigkeitsentwicklung. - Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in globalen, funktionsübergreifenden und Matrixorganisationen. - Kommerzielle Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, Service-Portfolios und Lebenszyklus zu verwalten. - Starke analytische, Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. - Fähigkeit, technische / betriebliche Anforderungen in skalierbare Serviceangebote zu übersetzen. - Kunden- und sicherheitsorientiert, mit proaktivem und kollaborativem Ansatz. descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Sales & Service Leader

__

In this role you will lead the Sales, Service and Project Execution organization of ABB’s Critical Power Business Line in Switzerland and Austria. You will be accountable for overall business performance, strategy implementation and challenging growth targets achievement and will be reporting into the Critical Power, Regional, Sales and Service and Project Execution Leader.

Working model: #LI-Hybrid

You’re main responsibilities:

  • Overseeing and implementing the Critical Power business line
  • commercial strategy (sales, tendering, project execution and services) in the relevant countries and evaluating market opportunities and deploying appropriate actions in alignment with Business Line’s objectives.
  • Building and maintaining effective relationships with external stakeholders (e.g. channels, end-users, consultants, suppliers) to ensure commercial success and improve customer satisfaction in the relevant countries. Additionally, working closely with relevant Business Line functions (Project Management, Services, Operations) to support operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
  • Ensuring pre-sales, tendering, system engineering and product marketing functions are properly staffed and aligned with Business Line requirements across country.
  • Delivering projects on schedule/quality/cost and in alignment with ABB’s project management frameworks as well as managing after-sales support and overall service business in the region in alignment with Business Line objectives.

Your background:

  • Postgraduate degree or above, in Business or Engineering field. MBA preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in UPS industry or Data Center Industry. Furthermore, wide network across data center and semiconductor industry as well as IT channels.
  • Solid influencing skills working across functions, geography, and segments as well as experience in managing large local/regional high-performance organizations and implementing change in a matrix organization.
  • Familiar with tendering, commissioning and project management processes.
  • Previous experience in electric (High, Medium Low Voltage Products and Systems) and automation industry. therefore, familiar with tendering, commissioning and project management processes.
  • Understanding of mission critical segments: Data Center, Semiconductor, Infrastructure, Utility Knowledge of the industry, local governmental requirements, today’s global market conditions, full awareness of the sales function technicalities/methodologies, usage of SAP and other modern day smart tools, and how to use them to serve business and customer requirements.
  • Fluent written and oral communications in English and German as well as willingness to travel 25%

What we offer:

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work options
  • Generous vacation allowance (typically 27–30 days)
  • Strong emphasis on learning & development
  • Fitness/health programs or partnerships

More about us:

ABB’s Smart Power division is a technology leader in data centers, energy transition and smart industries. Its core product portfolio makes electricity safe and reliable.

Smart Power’s teams create efficient, intelligent solutions that deliver an unbeatable customer experience and help make a zero-carbon future possible.

This recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Partner, at ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Project Operations Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for the operational execution of medium-size customer projects within the Medium Voltage Switchgear business, from order handover through delivery and close-out. You will ensure disciplined project execution in line with contractual requirements, internal processes, and quality standards. Acting as the central coordination point, you will closely interface international factories, engineering, production, logistics, and local stakeholders to ensure reliable delivery, cost control, and customer satisfaction.

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

This role is contributing to the Medium Voltage Switchgear business within the Electrification Distribution Solutions division in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

- Owning end-to-end project execution towards the customer, coordinating with factory-based project managers, engineering, production, and logistics to deliver according to scope, schedule, cost, and quality commitments.

- Actively driving detailed planning, progress tracking, expediting, and interface management, with a strong focus on delivery reliability, issue resolution, and adherence to milestones.

- Managing project financials, risks, changes, and claims in close alignment with internal stakeholders, ensuring early identification of deviations and implementation of corrective actions.

- Leading project close-out activities, including customer acceptance, documentation completeness, and the structured capture, evaluation, and implementation of lessons learned to continuously improve project execution.

• Qualifications for the role:

- You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering field, or a higher professional education qualification in engineering (e.g. Höhere Fachschule), with strong relevance to electrical products and systems.

- You have several years of hands-on experience managing or coordinating industrial customer projects, ideally within medium voltage switchgear, or complex engineered products.

- You have solid practical experience applying project management methodologies (e.g. IPMA, PMP, or equivalent) in an operational, delivery-focused environment.

- You are highly proficient in project execution tools, including MS Office, MS Project, SharePoint, Teams, and SAP, and use them actively to drive transparency and control.

- You are confident working with international factories and cross-functional teams, with strong skills in interface management, expediting, and problem solving.

- You bring sound knowledge of contracts, change management, and claim handling, and are comfortable addressing deviations with internal and external stakeholders.

- You communicate fluently in German and English (minimum C1 level in both), demonstrate a pragmatic, resilient mindset, and are comfortable operating in a fast-paced, execution-driven environment.

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions division provides medium voltage components, switchgear, and solutions that connect and protect the evolving electrical grid, ensuring reliable and predictable energy distribution. We link high-voltage systems to medium and low-voltage consumers, ensuring continuous power delivery to industrial, commercial, and residential users while enabling the integration of renewable energy sources into the grid. Our smart solutions, powered by AI, enhance grid resilience and optimize the usage of the electrical system.

With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 46 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, protection relays, instrument transformers, sensors and solutions for distribution stations.

We support our customers and partners in staying ahead of increasing electrification needs, technology, and regulatory changes, providing the power to adapt to a rapidly evolving energy landscape.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). The recruiting process is being led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com .

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__


Your role and responsibilities

The mission of this team is to bring modern and disruptive power electronic solutions from research into product development. We improve our products by holistic optimization, pushing forward novel converter topologies as well as optimizing key components. By joining us, you will participate in idea generation at the frontier of academic research and industrial applications, as well as in the development of advanced technologies for ABB’s products.

Do you want to contribute to a greener future by utilizing advanced and highly efficient power-electronic solutions for various applications? Get in touch with us! A young, multinational team is looking forward to welcoming you as their latest team member!

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Simulating and optimizing power electronic topologies and converters for various applications including conducting broad system level studies.

  • Leading and participating in converter design projects in collaboration with the business while mentoring juniors.

  • Designing, implementing, and testing converter prototypes in the lab.

  • Driving innovation by developing new power electronic concepts and solutions.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD with emphasis on power electronics converter design, optimization, and prototyping. Additional relevant industrial experience is a plus.

  • Hands-on laboratory skills, a willingness to work independently and take initiative in designing, building, and testing converter prototypes. A broader set of skills is expected.

  • Experience with setting-up converter testing by means of circulating power in a back-to-back configuration will be advantageous.

  • Experience in design, commissioning and testing of medium voltage and 3-phase grid connected inverters/rectifiers will be advantageous.

  • Experience in applied control theory including hardware implementation of control for power electronic systems can be advantageous.

  • Fluency in English, both spoken and written.


More about us

At the ABB research center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Materials

__

Your role and responsibilities:
In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain vocational experience through a temporary work placement. Each day, you will acquire knowledge by performing tasks as directed. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting ABB’s operations and enhancing personal education/employment opportunities.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Materials team at the ABB corporate research center in Switzerland. In the frame of a six-month internship scheduled to start in August or September 2026, you will be able to put theory into practice by contributing to our projects related to future energy technologies.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contribute to current technology development projects focusing on sustainable thermoplastic and thermoset polymers
  • Optimize processing and curing conditions of the materials at laboratory scale
  • Characterize thermal, mechanical and electrical properties, and investigate surface wettability and accelerated aging performance of sustainable polymer materials
  • Perform polymer recycling experiments to enable a circular polymer economy
  • Analyze and document experimental data, present results to the project team, and contribute to technical discussions

You will join a highly motivated and multidisciplinary team that is passionate about materials, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor`s or Master`s degree in Chemistry, Materials Science/Engineering, or a related discipline (completion of at least six semesters); official enrollment is essential
  • General understanding of and interest in polymer materials
  • Fundamental knowledge in polymers is of advantage
  • Experience in laboratory work and know-how in experimental methods
  • Motivated, self-motivated mindset and ability to work independently
  • Highly conscientious individual with a keen sense of responsibility
  • Fluent command of English, both written and spoken; German is a plus

What's in it for you

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

More about us

ABB Corporate Research, in close collaboration with its different business areas, is developing the foundations for the next generation of ABB products.

The Materials team at ABB’s Swiss research center in the proximity of Zurich focuses on the development and manufacturing of innovative materials to be implemented in the company’s future products. We are currently offering outstanding students the chance to join our multidisciplinary team of researchers in the field of metallic, composite and polymer materials.

The recruiting process is being led by Mara Werne, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Materials

__

Your role and responsibilities:
In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain vocational experience through a temporary work placement. Each day, you will acquire knowledge by performing tasks as directed. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting ABB’s operations and enhancing personal education/employment opportunities.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Materials team at the ABB corporate research center in Switzerland. In the frame of a six-month internship scheduled to start in July or August 2026, you will be able to put theory into practice by contributing to our projects related to future energy technologies.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • You will significantly contribute to our current research projects focusing on metals, alloys, and metal matrix composites as well as the associated manufacturing processes for ABB's innovative switchgear products
  • You prepare alloys and metal matrix composites and optimize their manufacturing processes on the lab-scale
  • You analyze materials and engineering prototypes using metallographic preparation, optical microscopy and other techniques to obtain a good understanding of the relationship between process parameters, microstructure, and material performance
  • You evaluate the obtained data, document your findings and present them to the team

You will join a highly motivated and multidisciplinary team that is passionate about materials, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • You currently pursue a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Materials Science/Engineering or a related discipline (completion of at least six semesters); official enrollment is essential
  • You have a general understanding of metals and metal matrix composite materials and the related processing technologies, and you are keen in deepening your knowledge in this field
  • You have experience in specimen preparation by metallography, microstructure analysis by light microscopy and you enjoy laboratory work
  • Experience in powder metallurgy, sintering, brazing, know-how in experimental methods (XRD, SEM, EDX, EBSD, Hardness, etc.) is an advantage
  • Fluent command of English, both written and spoken; German is a plus

What's in it for you

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

More about us

ABB Corporate Research, in close collaboration with its different business areas, is developing the foundations for the next generation of ABB products.

The Materials team at ABB’s Swiss research center in the proximity of Zurich focuses on the development and manufacturing of innovative materials to be implemented in the company’s future products. We are currently offering outstanding students the chance to join our multidisciplinary team of researchers in the field of metallic, composite and polymer materials.

The recruiting process is being led by Mara Werne, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Call to action

Be part of something bigger. This is where progress is powered, teams initiate action, and we move the world forward together. Run What Runs the World.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Tax Global Process and Transformation Le

__

The Data & Systems Modernization (DSM) Program was launched in April 2025 as a strategic initiative to build a unified, company-wide data and systems framework across ABB. Building on the foundations of the Finance Transformation Program (FTP) and the HR Transformation Program (HRTP), DSM aims to simplify our complex systems landscape, harmonize relevant non-finance master data, and establish a common ERP roadmap for the whole company.

The DSM Global Indirect Tax Technology Manager is a specialist role within the DSM program, forming part of the Indirect Tax Practice Team. The role acts as the single global design authority for indirect tax within enterprise platforms and Business-led transformation programs, ensuring that indirect tax is built in once and built right across the full business lifecycle.

The position partners closely with business areas, finance, IT, transformation programs (DSM and BA initiatives), and external providers to define, standardize, and govern indirect tax determination, controls, and reporting in core systems. The objective is to reduce complexity, risk, and cost while enabling scalable, future ready compliance.

This role is based in Europe and reports to the Global Indirect Tax Practice Lead.

Your
• Responsibilities:

-
Act as the single global indirect tax design authority for indirect tax across DSM, BA transformations, and core platforms (ERP, S/4HANA, CFIN).

-
Define and own a standard global indirect tax model covering tax codes, tax triggers, determination logic, and data dependencies.

-
Own global indirect tax determination for AR, AP, and Intercompany processes.

-
Ensure indirect tax is embedded end to end across the business lifecycle: master data, procurement, order management, delivery, billing, and reporting.

-
Enable centralized indirect tax decision making, reducing local deviations, rework, and project delays.

-
Partner with IS and transformation teams to design scalable, future proof solutions aligned with regulatory change (e.g. e invoicing, digital reporting).

-
Leverage core system capabilities (e.g. SAP DRC, CFIN) to ensure consistency and reuse, avoiding bespoke solutions.

-
Improve first-time-right outcomes to reduce audit, compliance and operational risk.

-
Serve as the single global point of contact for indirect tax technology across projects and operations.

-
Enable business growth through automated, compliant and efficient indirect tax processes

Your Experiences:

-
Significant experience in indirect tax technology, ERP tax determination ERP-enabled tax transformations, or indirect tax process design, gained in house and/or in a professional services environment.

-
Typically, 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in tax, including substantial ownership of tax technology, ERP implementations or global transformation initiatives.

-
Solid understanding of indirect tax across business processes, not limited to reporting.

-
Demonstrated experience working with global ERP platforms (e.g. SAP S/4 HANA) and tax related system design.

-
Ability to translate complex tax requirements into scalable system solutions and standards.

-
Experience working in global, multi stakeholder transformation environments.

-
Advanced analytical, problem solving, and decision-making skills.

-
Skilled in clear communication and stakeholder coordination

Desirable Experiences:

-
Experience with digital reporting and e invoicing frameworks (e.g. EU VAT reforms).

-
Exposure to large scale finance or ERP transformation programs.

-
Familiarity with SAP tax and reporting tools (e.g. SAP DRC, CFIN).

Why Join Us

This role offers the opportunity to develop the global indirect tax technology strategy of a multinational organization. The role works closely with senior stakeholders and plays a critical role in delivering compliant, efficient and sustainable indirect tax outcomes globally.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità:

In questo ruolo, contribuirai all'implementazione della nostra strategia di qualità in tutta l'unità organizzativa locale, promuovendo una forte cultura della qualità e implementando sistemi efficaci, strumenti e team qualificati, tutti incentrati sul superamento delle aspettative dei clienti e sul mantenimento di operazioni sostenibili. Ogni giorno, bilancerai prevenzione, miglioramento continuo e risposta rapida alle sfide di qualità, collaborando con team interfunzionali per migliorare i risultati di qualità. Il tuo lavoro supporterà direttamente l'unità organizzativa nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi di performance e nel progresso verso standard di livello mondiale.

Il modello di lavoro per questo ruolo è in sede: #LI-Onsite #Work-Shifts

Questo ruolo contribuisce alla divisione Critical Power, Smart Power presso Quartino, Svizzera.

Sarai principalmente responsabile di:

  • Supportare attivamente le linee di produzione come primo punto di contatto per le questioni relative alla qualità.
  • Tracciare e registrare sistematicamente tutte le non conformità generate dalle linee di produzione.
  • Contribuire al miglioramento degli indicatori chiave di qualità, principalmente il First Pass Yield (FPY) e il costo complessivo della scarsa qualità (COPQ).
  • Segnalare tempestivamente e accuratamente le non conformità al fornitore.
  • Controllare, implementare e migliorare continuamente i controlli di qualità per migliorare la qualità dei prodotti e il controllo dei processi.
  • Gestire il magazzino dei prodotti non conformi e lavorare attivamente per ridurre i livelli di inventario.

• Requisiti per il ruolo:

  • Tecnico meccanico o elettrico o settore correlato.
  • Minimo 2 anni di esperienza in ruoli relativi alla qualità o equivalenti.
  • Profonda conoscenza dei processi di qualità, comprese le metodologie di risoluzione dei problemi e gli strumenti di miglioramento continuo.
  • Capacità comunicative e interpersonali con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli organizzativi.
  • Disponibilità a lavorare su turni e oltre l'orario standard quando richiesto, e capacità di lavorare in modo efficiente in situazioni impegnative.
  • La lingua principale è l'italiano, scritto e parlato.
  • La conoscenza dell'inglese è considerata un vantaggio.

Si prega di notare che le candidature e i CV devono essere inviati in inglese.

Maggiori informazioni su di noi

ABB Smart Power fornisce soluzioni di distribuzione dell'energia per data center, impianti di produzione, infrastrutture critiche ed edifici commerciali. I team tecnici della Divisione lavorare a stretto contatto con i partner del settore, fornendo soluzioni avanzate che supportano la rapida crescita, transizione e gli obiettivi di sostenibilità. Il portafoglio della Divisione comprende interruttori industriali, sistemi a bassa tensione, applicazioni di avviamento motore e dispositivi di sicurezza come interruttori e relè. La sua unità Power Protection supporta le più grandi aziende di data center del mondo con soluzioni UPS avanzate ed efficienti dal punto di vista energetico. ABB Ability™ Energy Manager della Divisione fornisce una piattaforma scalabile e facile da usare che aiuta le organizzazioni a risparmiare energia e ridurre le emissioni di CO2.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

This position reports to:

Production Supervisor

__

Job Summary

Contributes to ensuring a safe working environment in compliance with company guidelines, guaranteeing the achievement of Production targets during the shift. Supports the Production Supervisors in the daily coordination of operational activities, providing technical assistance to operators in the assembly and packaging areas.

The work model for this role is on-site: #LI-Onsite

Main Roles and • Responsibilities

  • Monitoring and ensuring compliance with ABB safety guidelines and Code of Conduct during the shift

  • Supporting the Production Supervisor / Logistics Supervisor to ensure the correct execution of production activities

  • Providing technical support to operators (Assembly, Packaging) during daily operations

  • Acting as the reference point for on‑the‑job training of production personnel

  • Serving as the first level of contact for operational issues to be escalated to the relevant Production Supervisor

  • Participating in Level 1 Q Circles by gathering technical and quality issues and communicating them to the appropriate supervisor

License to Operate / Core Values

  • Ensuring that all personnel (within the area of responsibility) understand ABB’s core values and the group’s safety and integrity standards, and acting accordingly

  • Implementing and ensuring compliance with ABB’s Code of Conduct, tools, policies, and processes within the assigned area

Collaboration / Leadership

  • Promoting and enabling collaboration within the relevant work areas

  • Managing relationships with stakeholders in the area of responsibility and ensures alignment

Professional Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in operations, with experience in coordination roles

  • Experience in the electromechanical field

  • Previous experience in team coordination roles is considered a plus

Education

  • Vocational school diploma or equivalent

Please note that applications and CVs should be submitted in English.

More About Us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment process is managed by Mara Werne, Talent Partner.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop and implement people strategy through the execution of HR processes.   • Supporting the business and the execution of HR processes involved across the end-to-end employee lifecycle

Our team dynamics
You will join a dynamic, talented, high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

ABB Corporate Research, in close collaboration with its different business areas, is developing the foundations for the next generation of ABB products. We would like to give a motivated student an opportunity to complete a six-month internship with a multidisciplinary team at the Energy Storage group of ABB.

At ABB, we envision integration of Energy Storage systems for reliable and sustainable electrical mobility applications as well as for the power grids of the future. To realize this vision, we are developing advanced technological solutions that are based on various battery cell chemistries.

As an intern, you will contribute to advanced research projects in battery technology and advanced manufacturing.

• Your responsibilities will include:

  • Polymer Additive Manufacturing (3D Printing):
  • Operate and support polymer 3D printing processes using state‑of‑the‑art industrial-grade equipment for prototyping and functional components.
  • Development of Battery Test Setups:
  • Assist in the design, development, and assembly of battery test systems. This includes practical work such as designing innovative cell holders, building fixtures, and supporting laser-welding jig development.
  • Testing Operations & Data Analysis:
  • Support test maintenance, launch activities, and experimental campaigns. Collect, process, and analyze test data to contribute to research outcomes.
  • Battery Safety Testing Preparation:
  • Assist in the preparation of battery safety tests, including setup and integration of sensing and measurement equipment.
  • Research Support on Novel Battery Concepts:
  • Contribute to ongoing research activities focused on next-generation battery technologies, including experimental validation and documentation.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Currently pursuing a Master`s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or similar field
  • Interest in battery energy storage & state of the art technologies
  • Experience with CAD and additive manufacturing is required. Already maturated practical experience in a lab setting and working knowledge of Python is preferred
  • Proficiency in English
  • Willingness to learn and explore new research topics
  • Committed to learning and taking initiative
  • Ability to think conceptually and express ideas clearly and convincingly
  • Availability for six months (start and end dates are open for discussion)

Application Details:

Non-EU/EFTA citizens, please note that a certificate from your university, showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies, is required for the visa application.

More about us

Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions and services to electrify the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way. The portfolio includes medium- and low-voltage electrical components, switchgear, digital devices, enclosures, and circuit breakers, among others. With our products, solutions and services, we collaborate with customers to improve power delivery and security, enhance energy management, efficiency and operational reliability, as we seek to achieve a low carbon society. go.abb/electrification

We look forward to receiving your application.

The recruiting process is being led by Mara Werne, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

This role is contributing to the Power Protection, Smart Power division in Quartino, Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Non-Conformities Management: Analyze non-conformities systematically to identify root causes and initiate cases in the Practical Problem Solving (PPS) tool to track corrective activities and ensure resolution.

  • PPS cases Management: Define containment, corrective, and preventive actions. Facilitate Level 2 Quality Circles and escalate critical cases to Level 3 when necessary.

  • Quality KPI Performance: contribute to the improvement of key quality metrics including First Pass Yield (FPY) manufacturing, Supplier PPM, Customer DPU, and overall Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ). Monitor and ensure timely closure of PPS cases.

  • Supplier Quality Management: Manage supplier non-conformities and identify top critical issues in collaboration with the Supplier Quality Manager to improve initiatives.

  • Production Support: Support Quality Technicians by identifying improvement opportunities to prevent non-conformities and minimize production disruptions.

  • Quality Gates Development: Develop new quality gates and continuously improve existing to enhance product quality and process control.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor's degree or SSST in Electrical Engineering or related field.

  • Minimum five years of experience in quality or equivalent role.

  • Deep understanding of quality processes, including problem-solving methodologies and continuous improvement tools.

  • Communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all organizational levels. Willingness to work beyond standard hours when required and ability to perform efficiently in demanding situations.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage tasks efficiently and collaboratively in a constantly evolving manufacturing environment characterized by regular adjustments and shifts.

  • Fluency in English and Italian (written and spoken).

  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification is considered an advantage.



More about us

ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected, and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Führen Sie, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Quality Manager


Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

>In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, den Einsatz der Qualitätsstrategie für eine lokale Organisationseinheit zu unterstützen, einschließlich Qualitätskultur, Systeme, Tools und qualifizierte Teams, mit dem Ziel, die Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen und gleichzeitig einen nachhaltigen Betrieb zu gewährleisten. Jeden Tag unterstützen Sie das Unternehmen bei der Schaffung der richtigen Mischung aus Prävention, kontinuierlicher Verbesserung, robuster Ursachenanalyse, schneller Reaktion und nachhaltigen Problemlösungen. Sie werden auch Ihre Fähigkeiten präsentieren, indem Sie mit lokalen Funktionen zusammenarbeiten, die die Qualität der Ergebnisse verbessern, um die Ziele für die Organisationseinheit zu erreichen und eine erstklassige Leistung anzustreben.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist vor Ort. #LI-Onsite

Diese Rolle trägt zur Division Power Protection, Smart Power in Quartino, Schweiz bei.

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Non-Conformities Management: Analysieren Sie systematisch Nichtkonformitäten, um Ursachen zu identifizieren und Fälle im PPS-Tool (Practical Problem Solving) einzuleiten, um Korrekturaktivitäten zu verfolgen und eine Lösung zu gewährleisten.

  • PPS-Fällemanagement: Definieren von Eindämmungs-, Korrektur- und Präventivmaßnahmen. Erleichtern Sie Qualitätskreise der Stufe 2 und eskalieren Sie kritische Fälle bei Bedarf auf Stufe 3.

  • Quality KPI Performance: tragen Sie zur Verbesserung der wichtigsten Qualitätskennzahlen bei, einschließlich der Herstellung von First Pass Yield (FPY), Lieferanten-PPM, Kunden-DPU und Gesamtkosten für schlechte Qualität (COPQ). Überwachung und Gewährleistung der rechtzeitigen Schließung von PPS-Fällen.

  • Supplier Quality Management: Verwalten von Lieferanten-Nichtkonformitäten und Ermittlung kritischer Hauptprobleme in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Supplier Quality Manager, um Initiativen zu verbessern.

  • : Unterstützung von Qualitätstechnikern durch die Identifizierung von Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten, um Nichtkonformitäten zu verhindern und Produktionsstörungen zu minimieren.

  • Quality Gates Development: Entwicklung neuer Qualitätsgates und kontinuierliche Verbesserung bestehender Qualitätsgates zur Verbesserung der Produktqualität und Prozesskontrolle.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Bachelor-Abschluss oder SSST in Elektrotechnik oder verwandten Bereichen.

  • Mindest fünf Jahre Erfahrung in Qualität oder gleichwertige Rolle.

  • Tiefes Verständnis von Qualitätsprozessen, einschließlich Problemlösungsmethoden und Tools zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.

  • Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, sich effektiv mit Stakeholdern auf allen organisatorischen Ebenen auseinanderzusetzen. Bereitschaft, bei Bedarf über die Standardstunden hinaus zu arbeiten und in anspruchsvollen Situationen effizient zu arbeiten.

  • Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, Aufgaben effizient und gemeinschaftlich in einer sich ständig weiterentwickelnden Fertigungsumgebung zu verwalten, die durch regelmäßige Anpassungen und Schichten gekennzeichnet ist.

  • Fluency in Englisch und Italienisch (schriftlich und gesprochen).

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à dépasser - plus maigre et plus propre. Ici, le progrès est une attente - pour vous, votre équipe, et le monde. En tant que leader mondial du marché, nous vous donnerons ce dont vous avez besoin pour que cela se produise. Il n'a pas toujours été facile, la croissance prend du grain. Mais à ABB, vous ne fuirez jamais seul. Exécutez ce qui fonctionne dans le monde.

Ce poste relève de:

Gestionnaire de la qualité


Votre rôle et responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion d'appuyer le déploiement de la stratégie de qualité pour une unité organisationnelle locale, y compris la culture de qualité, les systèmes, les outils et les équipes compétentes, dans le but de répondre aux attentes des clients tout en assurant des opérations durables. Chaque jour, vous aiderez l'organisation à créer le bon mélange de prévention, d'amélioration continue, d'analyse robuste des causes profondes, de réponse rapide et de solutions durables aux problèmes. Vous présenterez également vos compétences en collaborant avec des fonctions locales qui améliorent la qualité des résultats pour atteindre les objectifs de l'unité organisationnelle et viser un rendement de calibre mondial.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est sur place. #LI-Onsite

Ce rôle contribue à la division Power Protection, Smart Power à Quartino, en Suisse.

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Gestion des non-conformités: Analyser systématiquement les non-conformités afin d'identifier les causes profondes et d'initier les cas dans l'outil de résolution des problèmes pratiques (SPP) afin de suivre les activités correctives et d'assurer leur résolution.

  • SPP Gestion des cas : Définir les mesures de confinement, de correction et de prévention. Faciliter les cercles de qualité de niveau 2 et faire passer les cas critiques au niveau 3, au besoin.

  • Qualité Performance de l'ICP : contribuer à l'amélioration des principales mesures de qualité, y compris la fabrication du rendement du premier passage (APP), le PPM du fournisseur, le PPU du client et le coût global de la mauvaise qualité (DPQ). Surveiller et assurer la fermeture en temps opportun des cas de SP.

  • Gestion de la qualité des fournisseurs : Gérer les non-conformités des fournisseurs et cerner les principaux problèmes critiques en collaboration avec le gestionnaire de la qualité des fournisseurs afin d'améliorer les initiatives.

  • Soutien à la production : Soutenir les techniciens de la qualité en identifiant les possibilités d'amélioration pour prévenir les non-conformités et minimiser les perturbations de la production.

  • Développement de barrières de qualité : Élaborer de nouvelles barrières de qualité et améliorer continuellement les pratiques existantes pour améliorer la qualité des produits et le contrôle des procédés.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Bachelor's degree or SSST in Electrical Engineering or related field.

  • Minimum cinq années d'expérience en qualité ou en rôle équivalent.

  • Compréhension approfondie des processus de qualité, y compris les méthodes de résolution de problèmes et les outils d'amélioration continue.

  • Compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles avec les intervenants à tous les niveaux organisationnels. Volonté de travailler au-delà des heures normales, au besoin, et capacité de fonctionner efficacement dans des situations exigeantes.

  • Capacité démontrée de gérer les tâches efficacement et en collaboration dans un environnement de fabrication en constante évolution, caractérisé par des ajustements et des changements réguliers.

  • Fluency in English and Italian (written and please).

  • La certification Six Sigma Green Belt est considérée comme un avantage.



Plus sur nous

ABB Smart Power est un leader technologique mondial, avec des produits et des solutions qui font des alimentations électriques intelligentes, connectées et protégées. Ses produits et solutions intelligents rendent l'énergie plus compétitive en améliorant l'efficacité énergétique, la productivité et la fiabilité de presque toutes les opérations.

Nous valorisons les gens de différents horizons. Ça pourrait être votre histoire ? Postuler aujourd'hui ou visiter www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur nous et en apprendre davantage sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

Le processus de recrutement est dirigé par Julia Farin, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.
