descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

IS Service Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will have the opportunity to own software solution architecture across multiple architecture categories and ensure its alignment with enterprise and data architecture standards. Each day, you will be responsible for the design and build, integrity, and quality of an Information Systems (IS) solution and associated IS services delivered to business. You will also showcase your expertise by consulting, advising, and supporting on the installation of new IS solutions/services, or changing existing IS solutions/services.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Ensuring that the IS solutions/services provide the required functionality, meet the expectations of business and are reliable, maintainable, compliant, and auditable.

  • Approving, signing-off, and building any solution to be implemented on ABB production environment, within the respective service line, ensuring required quality and safety standards.

  • Contributing to IS problem and incident management by identifying and eliminating the reoccurring defects.

  • Defining the technical IS solution and ensuring alignment with other modules and surrounding IS applications through cooperation and collaboration among IS solution architects and IS delivery units.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed apprenticeship (EFZ) or equivalent qualification

  • Good communication skills in German and English (both written and spoken)

  • First professional experience is a plus (internship or entry-level experience)

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team

  • Basic knowledge of MS Office (e.g., Outlook, Excel, Teams)


More about us
This recruitment process is led by talent partner, Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

You will join an agile, cross‑functional team of approximately 8–15 employees focused on designing and developing new products.

This role is contributing to the Power Protection/EL/SP/R&D in Switzerland.

The work model for the role is: On Site

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Working as an independent and reliable contributor in R&D projects with limited supervision.

  • Understanding and applying applicable processes, standards, guidelines, and requirements, including architectural and design constraints.

  • Driving the achievement of assigned targets (quality, time, scope, cost) and raising and addressing risks.

  • Design and develop power converters

  • Specify components and define technical requirements with suppliers

  • Support the overall design cycle of the new product, from simulation to validation and documentation, through design and test

  • Conduct and coordinate complex analyses, develop recommendations based on technology/engineering practices and business considerations

  • Support operations and after sales organization during trouble shooting phases

  • Plan and coordinate a range of complex technology/engineering activities


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Master in Electrical/Electronics Engineering with thesis in Power Electronics or Bachelors Degree in Electrical/Electronics and equivalent work experience

  • 6+ years of electrical engineering experience

  • Experience with power electronic design topologies, knowledge of UPS technology and familiarity with the power protection

  • Mastering simulation tools -MATLAB/Simulink, LT Spice- and programming language -C-

  • Good communication skills in English, both oral and written. Other languages are an asset

  • Significant experience in working within complex organization

  • Willingness to travel occasionally (10%)


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Design and develop power converters

  • Specify components and define technical requirements with suppliers

  • Support the overall design cycle of the new product, from simulation to validation and documentation, through design and test

  • Conduct and coordinate complex analyses, develop recommendations based on technology/engineering practices and business considerations

  • Support operations and after sales organization during trouble shooting phases

  • Plan and coordinate a range of complex technology/engineering activities

  • 6+ years of electrical engineering experience

  • Experience with power electronic design topologies, knowledge of UPS technology and familiarity with the power protection

  • Mastering simulation tools -MATLAB/Simulink, LT Spice- and programming language -C-

  • Significant experience in working within complex organization

  • Willingness to travel occasionally (10%)

This position reports to:

Continuous Improvement Manager

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support production process definition to ensure optimization of cost, quality, and on-time delivery of product. Each day, you will participate in the sequence definition, cycle time calculation, and analysis of the working phases of new production processes/products. You will also showcase your knowledge by sharing TPM and cycle time data and improvement ideas with internal teams.

Work model: #LI-Onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • TPM (Total Productive Maintenance):

  • Handle tool management activities, including but not limited to maintenance, purchasing, standardization, and ensuring functionality and calibration.

  • Assure production line availability assuring preventative maintenance is adhered to and review data to support improvement interventions.

  • Collaborate with internal customers and external suppliers to meet tool requirements.

  • Project Support:

  • Support Continuous Improvement Specialist with lean projects

  • Training:

  • Develop and implement training documents for TPM, 5S, ESD and other relevant areas.

  • Conduct training sessions for coworkers to enhance their skills and knowledge.

  • Time Keeping:

  • Perform time studies on all prioritized process steps to identify opportunities for improvement and increased efficiency.

  • Ensure the documented times in SAP are correct to actual base line times from your measured time study.

  • Order Processing:

  • Place and confirm orders in “Smart Buy”.

  • Tracking of orders to assure correct and timely arrival.

Your • Qualifications

  • Demonstrated a clear focus on safe work practices with a dedication to following all relevant workplace safety guidelines

  • Demonstrated work ethic characterized by motivation, willingness to handle tasks, and a willingness to take initiative.

  • Comfortable in a teaching environment with the ability to effectively communicate information to a group but also to tailor your teaching approach for individualized learning experiences.

  • Good knowledge of current tools used in operations.

  • Experience working with SAP, Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.

  • Good organization, collaborative and problem-solving skills.

  • Minimum of two years of experience in UPS manufacturing.

  • Yellow Belt certified and English language a plus

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Industrial Software Systems

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a research scientist in Software Systems Engineering, you will be working on the future architecture and design of ABB’s software-based products, with a special focus on the digitalization of industrial systems. We are looking for a team member with a proven research track record and the eagerness to transfer and apply world class academic research into an industrial environment. You will work within the highly motivated, international team of scientists at ABB Research. • We offer an open and innovative international work environment with many diverse opportunities to grow your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contribute to and/or lead research projects that turn state-of-the-art research results into effective software solutions for ABB.
  • Create prototypes of innovative concepts with real business impact
  • Evaluate new technologies and assess their impact on ABB products and roadmaps.
  • Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports.
  • Build a network in the company and actively disseminate your knowledge and expertise.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or in a related field

  • Experience in software engineering and system design
  • Theoretical and practical knowledge in one or multiple of the following topics: software engineering, distributed systems, computer networking, embedded systems, machine learning, cyber security
  • Hands-on experience in programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, Rust)
  • Proven publication track record at top scientific conferences and journals
  • Excellent communication skills and team player attitude
  • Solid experience of getting ideas from concepts to prototypes


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:
  • Flexible Work Practices
  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan
  • Canteen

More about us


At the ABB Research Center located in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on cutting-edge technologies that shape the future of our products. The Industrial Software Systems research team explores topics like machine learning, cybersecurity, computer networking, distributed systems, and real-time systems. Our solutions are used to support the development of next-generation digital products and services of ABB.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

We empower you to take initiative, explore new possibilities, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Continuous Improvement Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the deployment of the continuous improvement strategy for a local organizational unit, including promoting a culture of constant learning and improvement. Each day, you will mentor and coach teams to operational excellence and improved results. You will also showcase your leadership skills by deploying and leading projects to enhance and sustain local business performance.

The work model for the role is on-site. #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification Power Protection manufacturing department in Quartino.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Aligning local continuous improvement strategies with ABB’s global initiatives, ensuring consistent execution and measurable impact.

  • Implementing operational excellence strategies in safety, lean production system, Internal PPAP, and cost through cross-functional collaboration.

  • Supporting capability building by developing and delivering targeted training modules and toolkits tailored to local business needs.

  • Managing product and process development across departments and suppliers, including PFMEA, production line setup, tooling, and line feeding of material.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Master’s in Business Engineering and Production (or equivalent) and Green Belt certified.

  • 2+ years in production engineering, specializing in Power Electronics assemblies.

  • Proficient in continuous improvement tools like FMEA, Lean, 5S, Yamazumi, VSM, and ABC XYZ analysis etc.

  • Experienced with SAP, BOM analysis, and work cycle optimization.

  • Skilled in project cost evaluation and capital investment justification.

  • Safety-focused, with dedicated commitment to workplace safety standards.

  • Fluent in Italian, advanced English, both written and spoken, being a collaborative, solution-driven communicator.

More about us

ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected, and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.it:
ABB , aiutiamo le industrie a gestire più snella e più pulita, e ogni persona qui lo fa accadere. Sarete autorizzati a guidare, sostenuto per crescere, e orgoglioso dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiuta a gestire ciò che gestisce il mondo. Questa posizione riporta a: R&D Engineer Non lo so. Il vostro ruolo e responsabilità In questo ruolo, si avrà la possibilità di contribuire in modo significativo ai risultati di progetto di successo in tecnologia, software, prodotto e / o sviluppo di soluzioni, così come la proprietà intellettuale associata (IP). Ogni giorno, si agirà come primo punto di contatto in Ricerca e Sviluppo per specifiche problematiche e manutenzione del prodotto. Potrai inoltre mostrare le tue competenze identificando, proponendo e implementando soluzioni innovative. Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è: ibrido. Questo ruolo contribuisce all'Electrification Smart Power a livello globale. I principali stakeholder sono R&D, Service, Sales Team e Clienti. Sarete principalmente responsabili per: - No. Mantenere competenze riconosciute in un settore specifico integrando gli ultimi sviluppi in tecnologie, strumenti e metodologie nel vostro lavoro. - No. Trovare nuovi modi di risolvere i problemi seguendo le vostre idee, creando ipotesi e definendo modi per convalidarli. - No. Documentazione dei risultati del lavoro (come risultati, progetti o software), permettendo ad altri di mantenere e migliorare. - No. Comprendere e avviare la generazione di IP nella vostra area di specializzazione e partecipare allo sviluppo di strategia IP del progetto. La nostra dinamica di squadra Ti unirai a una squadra ad alte prestazioni, dove potrai prosperare.
• Qualifiche per il ruolo - No. Siete altamente qualificati e appassionati nella modellazione e nella simulazione di reti di distribuzione elettrica, sia in AC che in DC, compresi i Convertitori di potenza, Interruttori di circuito, Fusibili, ecc. - No. Hai 5 anni di esperienza in Analisi della selettività, Flussi di carico e Analisi Transienti & Ottimizzazione - No. Esperienza nel lavoro come Senior Power Systems Architetto con strumenti di ingegneria informatici - No. Siete qualificati in MATLAB - Simulink, PSCAD, PowerFactory, PSS®E, EMTP-ATP, ecc. - No. Esperienza dimostrata in Ingegneria Elettrica (Power Electronic Systems) - No. Sei a tuo agio a comunicare in inglese (lingua italiana considerata un plus) Cosa c'è dentro per te? Ti forniamo il potere di prendere il comando, condividere idee audaci e modellare risultati reali. Crescerai attraverso esperienza pratica, mentorship e apprendimento che si adatta ai tuoi obiettivi. Qui, il vostro lavoro non importa solo, muove le cose in avanti Ulteriori informazioni su di noi ABB Smart Power fornisce soluzioni di distribuzione energetica per data center, impianti industriali e produttivi, infrastrutture critiche e edifici commerciali. I team tecnici della Divisione lavorano a stretto contatto con i partner del settore, offrendo soluzioni avanzate che supportano obiettivi di crescita rapida, transizione energetica e sostenibilità. Il portafoglio della Divisione comprende interruttori industriali, sistemi a bassa tensione, applicazioni di avviamento motore e dispositivi di sicurezza come interruttori e relè. La sua unità Power Protection supporta le più grandi aziende di data center del mondo con soluzioni UPS ad alta efficienza energetica. ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager offre una piattaforma scalabile e facile da usare che consente alle organizzazioni di risparmiare energia e ridurre le emissioni di CO2. Chiamata all'azione Guida il futuro. Questo è dove l'innovazione accelera, le industrie sono riprogettate, e i vostri poteri di impatto il mondo avanti. Gestisci ciò che corre il mondo. #ABBCareers # #RunwithABB # #Runwhatrunstheworld # # Agile # # Elettrificazione # #SmartPower # Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente prende tutti i tipi di menti: i curiosi, i coraggiosi e i creativi. Ecco perché accogliamo le persone da tutti gli sfondi e le esperienze. Pronti a fare un impatto? Applicare o visitare https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.

At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: R&D Engineer __ Your role and responsibilities In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute significantly to successful project results in technology, software, product, and/or solution development, as well as associated Intellectual Property (IP). Each day, you will act as the first point of contact in Research and Development for specific product-related issues and maintenance. You will also showcase your expertise by identifying, proposing, and implementing innovative solutions. The work model for the role is: hybrid. This role is contributing to the Electrification Smart Power globally. Main stakeholders are R&D, Service, Sales Teams, and Customers. You will be mainly accountable for: - Maintaining recognized expertise in a specific area by integrating the latest developments in technologies, tools, and methodologies into your work. - Finding new ways of solving problems by following your ideas, creating hypotheses, and defining ways to validate them. - Documenting work results (like findings, designs, or software), allowing others to maintain and improve them. - Understanding and initiating IP generation in your area of specialization and participating in the project IP strategy development. Our team dynamics You will join a high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.
• Qualifications for the role - You are highly skilled and passionate in modeling and simulating electrical distribution networks, both in AC and DC, including Power Converters, Circuit Breakers, Fuses, etc. - You have 5+ years of experience in Selectivity Analysis, Load Flows and Transients Analysis & Optimizations - Experience in working as Senior Power Systems Architect with Computer-Aided Engineering tools - You are qualified in MATLAB - Simulink, PSCAD, PowerFactory, PSS®E, EMTP-ATP, etc. - Proven experience in Electrical Engineering (Power Electronic Systems) - You are at ease communicating in English (Italian language considered as a plus) What’s in it for you? We empower you to take the lead, share bold ideas, and shape real outcomes. You’ll grow through hands-on experience, mentorship, and learning that fits your goals. Here, your work doesn’t just matter, it moves things forward More about us ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions. Call to Action Guide the future. This is where innovation accelerates, industries are reimagined, and your impact powers the world ahead. Run What Runs the World. #ABBCareers #RunwithABB #Runwhatrunstheworld #Agile #Electrification #SmartPower Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Sie werden ermächtigt, zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen, und stolz auf die Auswirkungen, die wir zusammen schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie zu laufen, was die Welt führt. Diese Position meldet: FuE-Ingenieur ... Ihre Rolle und Verantwortung In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, wesentlich zu erfolgreichen Projektergebnissen in der Technologie-, Software-, Produkt- und/oder Lösungsentwicklung sowie dem damit verbundenen Intellectual Property (IP) beizutragen. Jeden Tag fungieren Sie als erster Ansprechpartner in Forschung und Entwicklung für spezifische produktbezogene Probleme und Wartung. Sie präsentieren auch Ihr Know-how, indem Sie innovative Lösungen identifizieren, vorschlagen und implementieren. Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: hybrid. Diese Rolle trägt weltweit zur Electrification Smart Power bei. Hauptakteure sind R&D, Service, Sales Teams und Kunden. Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich für: - Ja. Bewahren anerkanntes Know-how in einem bestimmten Bereich durch Integration der neuesten Entwicklungen in Technologien, Tools und Methoden in Ihre Arbeit. - Ja. Finden Sie neue Möglichkeiten, Probleme zu lösen, indem Sie Ihren Ideen folgen, Hypothesen zu erstellen und Möglichkeiten zu definieren, sie zu validieren. - Ja. descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Supervisor

__

Job Summary

Contributes to ensuring a safe working environment in compliance with company guidelines, guaranteeing the achievement of Production targets during the shift. Supports the Production Supervisors in the daily coordination of operational activities, providing technical assistance to operators in the testing areas.

Your Roles and • Responsibilities

  • Monitoring and ensuring compliance with ABB safety guidelines and Code of Conduct during the shift

  • Supporting the Production Supervisor to ensure the correct execution of production activities

  • Providing technical support to operators (Testing) during daily operations

  • Acting as the reference point for on‑the‑job training of production personnel

  • Serving as the first level of contact for operational issues to be escalated to the relevant Production Supervisor

  • Participating in Level 1 Q Circles: gathers technical and quality issues and communicating them to the appropriate supervisor

The work model for this role is on-site: #LI-Onsite

License to Operate / Core Values

  • Ensuring that all personnel (within the area of responsibility) understand ABB’s core values and the group’s safety and integrity standards, and act accordingly

  • Implementing and ensuring compliance with ABB’s Code of Conduct, tools, policies, and processes within the assigned area

Collaboration / Leadership

  • Promoting and enabling collaboration within the relevant work areas

  • Managing relationships with stakeholders in the area of responsibility and ensures alignment

Professional Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in operations, with experience in coordination roles

  • Experience in the electrical/electronic field

  • Previous experience in team coordination roles is considered a plus

Education

  • Vocational school diploma or equivalent

Please note that applications and CVs should be submitted in English.

More About Us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment process is managed by Mara Werne, Talent Partner.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

This position reports to:
Global Training Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to design, develop and deliver technical trainings in person or remotely to participants across the globe. Each day, you will make sure to prepare highly qualified ABB and Channel Partner front-end sales personnel worldwide who are confident in their product knowledge, sales techniques, and ability to effectively communicate the value of our products and solutions to customers. You will also showcase your expertise by guaranteeing excellent customer service and securing high level of customer satisfaction through trainings.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the to the Critical Power business line in the Electrification Smart Power division. Main stakeholders are Sales, Product Management, Project Management, and Engineering.

You will be mainly accountable for:

- Preparing and delivering training courses in classroom, online, or on-site and following up on pre- and post-training activities (e.g., training needs and feedback collection, and preparing course material, tools, and equipment).

- Designing and developing lesson plans and course material for classroom, on-site and online training in own area of responsibility, and advising on updates needed in e-learning material. Creating and updating course descriptions and training programs. Considering feedback given on courses and implementing corrective actions to ensure continuous improvement

- Supporting the Center of Expertise Bid & Proposal and other teams/units in the Power Protection organization when necessary by using own expertise.

- Supporting Training Coordinators in making course arrangements, answering course enquiries, and providing proposals for training courses.

Our team dynamics
You will join a dynamic, motivated, and performing team, where you will be able to thrive.

• Qualifications for the role

- You have a minimum of 3 years’ experience in the critical power field, with roles in Training, Sales, Service, or R&D. Experience with UPS, STS, PDU, Power Conditioning Systems, and Battery Systems is desirable.

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent.

- Further education in adult teaching is a plus.

- Possess the ability to learn, understand, and apply new technologies.

- You enjoy working with methodologies for facilitating adult learning and communication.

- You possess a self-motivated mindset, are innovative in communication skills, and are passionate about interpersonal skills.

- You are at ease communicating in English. Proficiency in additional languages is beneficial.

Sarete principalmente responsabili per:

- Preparare e fornire corsi di formazione in aula, online o in loco e seguire le attività di pre- e post-formazione (ad esempio, le esigenze di formazione e la raccolta di feedback, e preparare materiale, strumenti e attrezzature del corso).

- Progettare e sviluppare piani di lezione e materiale didattico per l'aula, la formazione on-site e on-line nella propria area di responsabilità, e consigliare sugli aggiornamenti necessari in materiale e-learning. - Sostenere i coordinatori della formazione nell'organizzazione del corso, rispondere alle richieste dei corsi, e fornire proposte per corsi di formazione.

La nostra dinamica di squadra
Ti unirai a un team dinamico, motivato e performante, dove potrai prosperare.

- Hai un’esperienza minima di 3 anni nel campo della potenza critica, con ruoli in Formazione, Vendite, Servizio o R&D. L'esperienza con UPS, STS, PDU, sistemi di condizionamento di potenza e sistemi di batteria è auspicabile.

- Laurea o master in ingegneria elettrica o equivalente.

- L'ulteriore istruzione nell'insegnamento degli adulti è un vantaggio.

- Possede la capacità di imparare, capire e applicare nuove tecnologie.

- Ti piace lavorare con metodologie per facilitare l'apprendimento e la comunicazione degli adulti.

- Possiedi una mentalità auto-motivata, sono innovative nelle capacità di comunicazione, e sono appassionati di abilità interpersonali.

- Sei a tuo agio a comunicare in inglese. La competenza in altre lingue è utile.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente prende tutti i tipi di menti: i curiosi, i coraggiosi e i creativi. Ecco perché accogliamo le persone da tutti gli sfondi e le esperienze.

Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen – und jeder Mensch macht das hier. Sie werden ermächtigt, zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen, und stolz auf die Auswirkungen, die wir zusammen schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie zu laufen, was die Welt führt.

Diese Position meldet:
Global Training Manager

...

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortung

In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, technische Schulungen persönlich oder remote an Teilnehmer weltweit zu entwerfen, zu entwickeln und zu liefern. Jeden Tag stellen Sie sicher, hochqualifizierte ABB und Channel Partner-Front-End-Vertriebspersonal weltweit vorzubereiten, die in ihren Produktkenntnissen, Verkaufstechniken und in der Lage sind, den Wert unserer Produkte und Lösungen effektiv an Kunden zu kommunizieren. Sie präsentieren auch Ihr Know-how, indem Sie einen exzellenten Kundenservice und eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit durch Schulungen garantieren.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: hybrid

Diese Rolle trägt zur Critical Power Business-Linie im Bereich der Electrification Smart Power bei. Hauptakteure sind Vertrieb, Produktmanagement, Projektmanagement und Engineering.

Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

- Vorbereitung und Bereitstellung von Schulungen in Klassenzimmern, online oder vor Ort und auf Vor- und Nachbildungsmaßnahmen (z.B. Schulungsbedarf und Feedback-Sammlung, Vorbereitung von Kursmaterial, Werkzeugen und Geräten).

- Konzeption und Entwicklung von Unterrichtsplänen und Kursmaterial für Klassenzimmer, Vor-Ort- und Online-Ausbildung im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich und Beratung auf Updates, die im E-Learning-Material benötigt werden. Erstellung und Aktualisierung von Kursbeschreibungen und Trainingsprogrammen. Rückmeldungen zu Kursen und Durchführung von Korrekturmaßnahmen, um eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu gewährleisten

- Unterstützung des Center of Expertise Bid & Vorschlags und anderer Teams/Einheiten in der Power Protection Organisation, wenn nötig mit eigener Expertise.

- Unterstützung von Ausbildungskoordinatoren bei der Durchführung von Kursvereinbarungen, Beantwortung von Kursanfragen und Vorschlägen für Ausbildungskurse.

Unsere Teamdynamik
Sie werden sich einem dynamischen, motivierten und leistungsfähigen Team anschließen, in dem Sie gedeihen können.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

- Sie haben mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich der kritischen Macht, mit Rollen in Ausbildung, Vertrieb, Service oder R&D. Die Erfahrung mit UPS, STS, PDU, Power Conditioning Systems und Battery Systems ist wünschenswert.

- Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Elektrotechnik oder gleichwertig.

- Weiterbildung in der Erwachsenenbildung ist ein Plus.

- Ermöglicht die Fähigkeit, neue Technologien zu lernen, zu verstehen und anzuwenden.

- Sie arbeiten gerne mit Methoden zur Erleichterung des Lernens und der Kommunikation von Erwachsenen.

- Sie besitzen eine selbstmotivierte Denkweise, sind in Kommunikationsfähigkeiten innovativ und leidenschaftlich an zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten.

- Sie sind einfach auf Englisch kommunizieren. Vorteile in weiteren Sprachen sind vorteilhaft.

Chez ABB , nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres, et chaque personne ici fait que cela arrive. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à gérer ce qui dirige le monde.

Cette position porte sur :
Gestionnaire mondial de la formation

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion de concevoir, de développer et de fournir des formations techniques en personne ou à distance aux participants à travers le monde. Chaque jour, vous vous assurerez de préparer le personnel de vente ABB et Channel Partner hautement qualifié dans le monde entier qui sont confiants dans leurs connaissances des produits, techniques de vente, et la capacité de communiquer efficacement la valeur de nos produits et solutions aux clients. Vous présenterez également votre expertise en garantissant un excellent service à la clientèle et en assurant un haut niveau de satisfaction de la clientèle grâce à des formations.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est: hybride

Ce rôle contribue au secteur d'activité de Critical Power de la division Électrification Smart Power. Les principaux intervenants sont les ventes, la gestion des produits, la gestion de projet et l'ingénierie.

Vous serez principalement responsable de:

- Préparation et prestation de cours de formation en classe, en ligne ou sur place et suivi des activités de pré-formation et de post-formation (p. ex. besoins de formation et collecte de commentaires, préparation de matériel, d'outils et d'équipement).

- Concevoir et élaborer des plans de cours et du matériel didactique pour la formation en classe, sur place et en ligne dans son propre domaine de responsabilité, et donner des conseils sur les mises à jour nécessaires dans le matériel d'apprentissage en ligne. Création et mise à jour de descriptions de cours et de programmes de formation. Compte tenu de la rétroaction donnée sur les cours et la mise en œuvre de mesures correctives pour assurer une amélioration continue

- Soutenir le Centre d'expertise en matière de soumission et de proposition et d'autres équipes/unités de l'organisation Power Protection au besoin en utilisant son expertise.

- Aider les coordonnateurs de la formation à organiser des cours, à répondre aux demandes de formation et à proposer des cours de formation.

Notre dynamique d'équipe
Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique, motivée et performante, où vous pourrez prospérer.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

- Vous avez au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la puissance critique, avec des rôles dans la formation, la vente, le service ou la R-D. L'expérience avec UPS, STS, PDU, Power Conditioning Systems et Battery Systems est souhaitable.

- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie électrique ou équivalent.

- La formation continue dans l'enseignement des adultes est un plus.

- Possède la capacité d'apprendre, de comprendre et d'appliquer de nouvelles technologies.

- Vous aimez travailler avec des méthodologies pour faciliter l'apprentissage et la communication des adultes.

- Vous possédez un état d'esprit automotivé, sont innovants dans les compétences en communication, et sont passionnés par les compétences interpersonnelles.

- Vous êtes à l'aise pour communiquer en anglais. La maîtrise de langues supplémentaires est bénéfique.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous horizons et expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact ?

Faites une demande aujourd'hui ou visitez https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Engineering Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to optimize the Production organization’s assembly methods, processes, and equipment to minimize labor hours in accordance with business strategies related to quality, efficiency, costs, and safety. Each day, you will ensure appropriate production methods, cycle time, equipment performance, work instruction, and materials/components in support of production targets. You will also demonstrate your skills by defining the working phase sequence of a new production process to meet the targeted product cost and equipment investment budget.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Power Protection

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Identifying and recommending improvement opportunities and implements improvement projects, ensuring adherence to timeframe, quality, and cost requirements.
  • Providing the necessary work instruction
  • Ensure product maintenance through the introduction of the engineering change notice
  • Approving the design for processes developed internally or externally and performing final tests with respect to the project.
  • Providing support to Production during the internal process/equipment start-up, defining action plans and training relevant maintenance and production resources.
  • Evaluating new process technologies to improve productivity, quality, and cost reduction, defining and managing testing activities, approval criteria, and external provider choices.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Degree in Electric/Mechanic Engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience in operation and production line activities.
  • Knowledge of Engineering & Manufacturing Processes.
  • Proficiency in MS Office; preferred are: 2D/3D CAD systems, sap and Windchill.
  • Knowledge of the English language.
  • Positive spirit, self-motivation, team working, efficiency and problem-solving orientation; focus on delivering results by taking responsibility for assigned tasks and projects

Benefits:

  • Attractive compensation including bonus, 13th-month salary, and participation programs (ESAP).
  • Career development through targeted training and development opportunities.
  • REKA checks for leisure and travel.
  • Company holidays between Christmas and New Year.
  • Various discounts on sports equipment, electronics, and health & wellness offers.
  • Contribution toward gym membership.

More about us:

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

We look forward to receiving your application.

The recruiting process is led by Talent Partner Pedro Labian Sanchez.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Call to action

Be part of something bigger. This is where progress is powered, teams initiate action, and we move the world forward together. Run What Runs the World.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

In this role, you’ll help run what runs the world, by taking on meaningful work that drives real impact. We are looking for an R&D Senior Hardware Engineer to join our Electrification business. The selected candidate will join a team working on High Power DC converters.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Critical member of the Systems and Electrical team, Work within a multidisciplinary team to develop world class mission critical power protection equipment
  • Performs a variety of complex technology and engineering assignments
  • Realize the design of architecture and technical details, the circuit simulation and the development of electronic projects which require knowledge of analog, digital and low power electronics
  • Take care of design optimization by identification of technical, architectural and circuitry solutions, exploiting the highest integration (mechanical part, electrical components, PCBAs, etc.) and collaborating with other departments involved in the Product Development Process
  • Carry out preliminary tests for design pre-validation
  • Support the Test Lab during all the testing phases, evaluate reports of Test Lab and Quality Laboratories and express your definitive opinion on validation of final product
  • Draw up the technical documentation of systems, components, and interfaces

Our Team Dynamics

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor or Master’s degree in Electronics or Electrical Engineering
  • 5+ years' experience with electrical systems and complex power electronic systems.
  • Experience in digital and analog circuit design and simulation.
  • Experience with EMI design and troubleshooting
  • Knowledge of environmental, reliability, and safety requirements for Industrial products.
  • Knowledge and experience with Agile methodology is a plus.
  • Excellent command of English

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Critical Power unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Chapter Lead, Electronics HW __ You will utilize your extensive skills and technical expertise to select and qualify potential Energy Storage Systems and their manufacturers, ensure Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS) compatibility with those. You will further support us with new emerging applications around multifunction UPS for ancillary services such as frequency response and peak shaving. The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid You will be mainly accountable for: - Lead technical qualification of Energy Storage Systems (eg. battery cells, battery racks, Battery Management Systems, etc.) - Support supplier qualification - Support certification of batteries and systems for the American and IEC standards - Support on new emerging applications and technical know-how on batteries - Identify and communicate energy storage requirements 
• Qualifications for the role: - Master or Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, as well as more than 3 years of relevant Engineering experience - Must have experience working with electrical systems or demonstrate the aptitude to learn complex power electronic systems - Must have experience with energy storage systems and batteries - Self-driven and responsible, well-structured work practices - Can break down complex topics into simple explanations - Collaborative team player - Knowledge and experience with Agile methodology is a plus - Fluent in English, spoken and written More about us ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Critical Power unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions. ## Descrizione
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Chapter Lead __ Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions and services to electrify the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way. The portfolio includes medium- and low-voltage electrical components, switchgear, digital devices, enclosures, and circuit breakers, among others. With our products, solutions and services, we collaborate with customers to improve power delivery and security, enhance energy management, efficiency and operational reliability, as we seek to achieve a low carbon society. go.abb/electrification. In this role you will be part in pioneering a new way of working within our Smart Power Division. You will implement and lead the Agile practices at team level for one or more teams. You will guide on the Agile principles, helping the team to achieve valuable outcomes, and identify continuous improvement, bringing a data driven approach in day‑to‑day management. The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

## Mansioni
- Guide and coach Scrum teams in applying Agile practices and principles, fostering positive team dynamics, collaboration, and continuous improvement
- Develop high‑performing teams by identifying strengths and areas for growth, using effective coaching techniques, and promoting empowering Agile behaviors
- Facilitate key Scrum event s (Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective) to ensure engagement, transparency, and smooth delivery
- Strengthen Agile maturity across the organization by building cross‑team alliances, improving Agile practices, and ensuring adherence to Scrum theory, practices, and guidelines

## Requisiti
- Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent (this position is not embedded in the IT environment; we are open for profiles with different backgrounds like psychology, social science, engineering, business administration, economics etc.)
- 5 or more years of e xperience as Scrum Master or in a similar Agile role applying Agile principles and practices is an advantage
- Fluent command of English with Italian considered as additional advantage
- Motivated to work in an Agile, dynamic workplace and cross functional team
- Experience in leading people with the ability to earn trust while challenging the team to improve and operate outside its comfort zone
- Strong creative problem – solving skills and the ability to get things done
- Excellent communication, facilitation, negotiation, coaching, risk management and conflict‑resolution skills, with the ability to foster positive team dynamics and collaboration

## Contatto
Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world. This Position reports to: Production Manager Your role and responsibilities The ABB Quartino plant is part of the Critical Power Business Line, where we develop and produce UPS systems designed to stabilize and ensure continuity of power grid supply at our global customers' facilities. The strong market expansion and expected volume increase in the coming years require an expansion of our production organization. The production structure is organized in Integrated Production Units (IPUs), divided by product type. Each IPU is autonomously organized so it can independently coordinate all the resources needed to ensure the required production outputs, while maintaining the expected quality and costs. For one of our IPUs we are looking for a Production Supervisor that will report to the IPU Leader and will work alongside the other IPUs coordinating the assigned product lines. You will ensure efficient and cost-effective production results that meet order demand, specifications, quality, and planning targets through the coordination and management of plant equipment, personnel, and production processes (quantity, quality, costs, and proper productivity level). The work model for the role is: #LI- onsite You will be mainly accountable for: - Operational & Production Management: Coordinate all production resources—personnel, equipment, and production area—to meet key operational targets including output, On-Time Delivery, and First Pass Yield, while actively participating in projects to optimize performance and working capital. - Team Leadership & Development: Lead, guide, and develop a high-performing production team by ensuring proper staffing and skills, providing coaching and motivation, and fostering a collaborative culture in line with HR policies and ABB's core values. - HSE & Compliance Ownership: Take full accountability for the Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) of your team, assessing risks and implementing plans to ensure strict compliance with all ABB integrity standards, local regulations, and the code of conduct. - Continuous Improvement & Training: Drive a culture of continuous improvement by collaborating with Operational Excellence teams to integrate lean manufacturing and Kaizen principles, while ensuring the implementation of necessary safety, technical, and process-related training programs for your organization. 
• Qualifications for the role - A degree in a technical discipline such as Electronics, Mechanics, or a related field. - A deep understanding of end-to-end production processes and logistics within a manufacturing environment. - A minimum of 5 years of proven experience in a production environment, including significant time in a Team Leader or supervisory capacity. - At least 3 years of hands-on leadership experience, with direct responsibility for managing and developing production teams or shop-floor personnel. - Demonstrated expertise in operational resource planning, including the organization of personnel, production equipment, and shift schedules. - Strong leadership and motivational skills, combined with a proven ability to manage conflicts and foster a collaborative team environment. - Fluency in Italian is required; a good working knowledge of English is a valuable asset More about us ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions. We look forward to receiving your application. Learn more about ABB at www.abb.com . Read our Data Privacy Statement . We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Diese Position berichtet an: Produktionsleiter Ihre Rolle und Verantwortung Das ABB Quartino-Werk ist Teil der Critical Power Business Line, wo wir UPS-Systeme entwickeln und produzieren, um die Kontinuität der Stromversorgung in unseren globalen Kundenanlagen zu stabilisieren und sicherzustellen. Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Hand-on-Führung, mit direkter Verantwortung für die Verwaltung und Entwicklung von Produktionsteams oder Shop-Floor-Personal. - Gezeigtes Know-how in der operativen Ressourcenplanung, einschließlich der Organisation von Personal, Produktionsanlagen und Schichtplänen. - Starke Führungs- und Motivationskompetenzen, kombiniert mit einer bewährten Fähigkeit, Konflikte zu verwalten und eine kollaborative Teamumgebung zu fördern. - Fluency auf Italienisch ist erforderlich; ein gutes Arbeitswissen von Englisch ist ein wertvolles Vermögen Mehr über uns ABB Smart Power bietet Energieverteilungslösungen für Rechenzentren, Industrie- und Fertigungsanlagen, kritische Infrastruktur und kommerzielle Gebäude. Die technischen Teams der Division arbeiten eng mit Industriepartnern zusammen und liefern fortschrittliche Lösungen, die schnelles Wachstum, Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeitsziele unterstützen. Das Portfolio der Division umfasst Industrieschaltungsschalter, Niederspannungssysteme, Motorstartanwendungen und Sicherheitseinrichtungen wie Schalter und Relais. Die Power Protection Unit unterstützt die weltweit größten Rechenzentrumsunternehmen mit fortschrittlichen energieeffizienten UPS-Lösungen. Der ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager der Division bietet eine skalierbare, einfach zu bedienende Plattform, die Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, Energie zu sparen und CO2-Emissionen zu reduzieren. Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à dépasser - plus maigre et plus propre. Ici, le progrès est une attente - pour vous, votre équipe, et le monde. Ce poste relève de : Gestionnaire de la production Votre rôle et vos responsabilités L'usine ABB Quartino fait partie de Critical Power Business Line, où nous développons et produisons des systèmes UPS conçus pour stabiliser et assurer la continuité de l'approvisionnement en réseau électrique dans les installations de nos clients mondiaux. La forte expansion du marché et l'augmentation prévue du volume dans les années à venir exigent une expansion de notre organisation de production. La structure de production est organisée en unités de production intégrées, divisée par type de produit. Chaque UIP est organisée de manière autonome afin de pouvoir coordonner de manière indépendante toutes les ressources nécessaires pour assurer les produits de production requis, tout en maintenant la qualité et les coûts escomptés. Pour l'une de nos UIP, nous sommes à la recherche d'un superviseur de la production qui relèvera du chef de l'UIP et travaillera avec les autres UIP en coordonnant les gammes de produits assignées. Vous assurerez des résultats de production efficaces et rentables qui répondent à la demande, aux spécifications, à la qualité et aux objectifs de planification grâce à la coordination et à la gestion des équipements, du personnel et des processus de production (quantité, qualité, coûts et niveau de productivité approprié). Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est: #LI- sur place Vous serez principalement responsable : - de la gestion opérationnelle et de la production : Coordonner toutes les ressources de production – du personnel, de l'équipement et de la zone de production – afin d'atteindre les objectifs opérationnels clés, y compris la production, la livraison en temps opportun et le rendement de First Pass, tout en participant activement à des projets visant à optimiser les performances et le fonds de roulement. - Leadership et perfectionnement de l'équipe : Diriger, guider et développer une équipe de production hautement performante en assurant une dotation et des compétences adéquates, en fournissant du coaching et de la motivation et en favorisant une culture de collaboration conforme aux politiques des RH et aux valeurs fondamentales de l'ABB. - HSE & Compliance Ownership : Rendre pleinement compte de la santé, de la sécurité et de l'environnement (HSE) de votre équipe, évaluer les risques et mettre en oeuvre des plans pour assurer le strict respect de toutes les normes d'intégrité ABB, de la réglementation locale et du code de conduite. - Amélioration et formation continues : Conduire une culture d'amélioration continue en collaborant avec des équipes d'excellence opérationnelle afin d'intégrer la fabrication maigre et les principes Kaizen, tout en assurant la mise en oeuvre des programmes de formation nécessaires en matière de sécurité, de technique et de processus pour votre organisation. 
• Qualifications pour le rôle - Diplôme dans une discipline technique comme l'électronique, la mécanique ou un domaine connexe. - Une compréhension approfondie des processus de production de bout en bout et de la logistique dans un environnement de fabrication. - Un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience prouvée dans un environnement de production, y compris un temps important dans un chef d'équipe ou une capacité de supervision. - Oui. Au moins 3 ans d'expérience pratique en leadership, avec la responsabilité directe de gérer et de développer des équipes de production ou du personnel d'atelier. - Expertise démontrée dans la planification des ressources opérationnelles, y compris l'organisation du personnel, du matériel de production et des horaires de travail. - Des compétences solides en leadership et en motivation, associées à une capacité éprouvée de gérer les conflits et de favoriser un environnement d'équipe collaborative. - Une bonne connaissance pratique de l'anglais est un atout précieux.En savoir plus sur nous ABB Smart Power fournit des solutions de distribution d'énergie pour les centres de données, les usines industrielles et manufacturières, les infrastructures critiques et les bâtiments commerciaux. Les équipes techniques de la Division travaillent en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires de l'industrie, fournissant des solutions avancées qui soutiennent la croissance rapide, la transition énergétique et les objectifs de durabilité. Le portefeuille de la Division comprend des disjoncteurs industriels, des systèmes à basse tension, des applications de démarrage de moteurs et des dispositifs de sécurité comme les commutateurs et les relais. Son unité de protection de l'énergie prend en charge les plus grandes entreprises de centres de données du monde avec des solutions UPS à haut rendement énergétique. La division ABB CapabilityTM Energy Manager fournit une plateforme évolutive et facile à utiliser qui aide les organisations à économiser de l'énergie et à réduire les émissions de CO2. This position reports to: R&D Team Lead __ General information The R&D Certification Engineer plays a fundamental role supporting strategic technology direction working with the R&D Senior Certification Engineer, by assisting and leading part of certification activities and providing guidance to all departments on the application of standards and regulations related to ABB’s Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS) systems. Your background - Technician diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Electronics or Electrotechnics. - Minimum 3 years of relevant engineering experience, including work with power electronic systems. - Knowledge of product regulations and standards (IEC, UL); familiarity with LCA and Environmental Sustainability is an advantage. - Experience working with certification bodies and conducting certification-related tasks. - Hands‑on experience with laboratory measurement equipment. - Ability to work independently on testing and certification activities. - Availability to perform certification tests in external laboratories (travel required). - Proficiency in Italian and English for effective communication. German is an asset. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. descriptionByLocale.en: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. This position reports to: Production Engineering Manager __ Your role and responsibilities In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop and maintain test infrastructures and test automations in accordance with business strategy to improve safety, efficiency, quality, and cost reduction. Each day, you will ensure existing test systems remain functional and up-to-date while designing new automated solutions for emerging products. You will also showcase your expertise by implementing innovative testing methodologies that enhance production standards and reduce costs. The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-Hybrid You will be mainly accountable for: - Maintaining and improving existing test systems, both hardware infrastructures and software automations, ensuring they meet current operational standards. - Designing new test systems for new products in compliance with specifications and manual test procedures, implementing automation wherever possible. - Providing support for the integration and startup of test systems, defining action plans and training relevant personnel. - Identifying and recommending opportunities for improving test processes and implementing related projects, ensuring adherence to safety requirements and evaluating new technologies. Qualifications for the role - You have a minimum of 3 years of experience in UPS testing or commissioning, with proven expertise in test system development and maintenance. - Highly skilled in hardware design and automation software development, with the ability to create robust and efficient testing solutions. - Possess an enhanced knowledge of electrical infrastructures design and software development in C programming language. - You are passionate about workplace safety and technical documentation, ensuring all systems comply with safety requirements and are properly documented. - Degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. - You are at ease communicating in English, both written and spoken. - Nice-to-have: Knowledge of programming languages such as LabVIEW, Python, and C#, experience with programming IDEs like LabWindows CVI and VSCode, and familiarity with hardware design software such as Altium. More about us ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected, and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation. descriptionByLocale.en: At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world. This Position reports to: Fulfillment Lead Your role and responsibilities Join ABB and become a vital part of our supply chain, ensuring the seamless flow of materials from our global suppliers to our production lines. In this critical role, you will be the central point of contact for purchasing and fulfillment, where your planning and problem-solving skills will directly impact our ability to deliver high-quality products to our customers on time, every time. The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid You will be mainly responsible for - End-to-End Order Management: Manage the entire purchasing lifecycle within SAP, from creating and releasing purchase orders to actively monitoring and expediting them to align with production schedules and customer delivery deadlines. - Supplier Performance & Partnership: Drive supplier excellence by monitoring key performance indicators such as on-time delivery, quality, and lead times. You will conduct performance reviews and proactively resolve issues to strengthen our supply chain partnerships. - Logistics Coordination & Problem Solving: Oversee the inbound logistics process, including freight and customs clearance. You will be the go-to expert for handling urgent delivery situations and managing non-conformance reports to ensure operational continuity. - Data Analysis & Process Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities to improve our fulfillment process by analyzing order backlogs, identifying root causes for delays, and implementing effective recovery plans. You will monitor and ensure the integrity of data exchanged through supplier EDI systems. Qualifications for the role - A degree or diploma in a technical field, Process Management, or Supply Chain Management. - Proven experience in a similar role within a manufacturing or industrial environment. - Strong, hands-on knowledge of SAP is essential for this role. - Excellent communication skills with fluency in both English and Italian. - A proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic setting. - Experience with order handling, inventory management, and data analysis would be a significant advantage. More about us ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions. We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Condurrà rassegne di prestazione e risolverà proattivamente le questioni per rafforzare le nostre partnership di catena di approvvigionamento. - Coordinamento Logistico & Risoluzione dei Problemi: Sovraintende il processo di logistica di entrata, compresa la spedizione e la liberazione doganale. Sarà l'esperto di riferimento per la gestione delle situazioni di consegna urgente e la gestione dei rapporti di non conformità per assicurare la continuità operativa. - Analisi dei Dati & Miglioramento dei Processi: Identifica proattivamente opportunità per migliorare il nostro processo di esecuzione analizzando i ritardi degli ordini, identificando le cause radici dei ritardi e implementando piani di recupero efficaci. descriptionByLocale.en: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. This position reports to: Global Project Operations Manager __ You are responsible for supporting sales and execution in contract and risks management and ensuring consistent management of all proposals and contracts. Define and deploy the best practices and guidelines to ensure consistent and complete preparation of global risk reviews. Oversight of the contract management process, bidding submission, contract negotiations and document management as required. Key Responsibilities - Responsible jointly with the Sales Responsible to develop project specific contractual strategies, risk assessments and corresponding cost provision considerations. Work with the sales and account management team on Frame Agreements. - Overviews the legal function in reviewing and commenting on the contractual tender terms and conditions and corresponding update of the Risk Review database. Actively participates in Risk Review preparation and meetings. - Support the continuous improvement of the contract and risk management process and other improvements (e.g. rev split agreement, etc.) within the Global Business Line. Develop and maintain contract and risk management training program and contribute to regular Sales Operations Handbook updates. - Support the handover of all relevant contract and risk management aspects from tendering to execution stage. - Participate in project reviews to identify contract and risk management aspects to be addressed and support definition of corresponding mitigation strategies upon request (e.g. notifications, claims, variation orders, etc.). Participate in lessons learned exercises to assess and outline the contract and risk management related improvement areas and to divulgate the improvement actions within the organization. - Support Legal function in handling formal dispute resolution (mediation, litigation or arbitration) as required. - Maintain overview and track all ongoing significant contractual issues and communicate with business partners and management on an ongoing basis. - Be the first point of contact and act as interface between business and corresponding Group or Corporate function to address project related commercial, tax and insurance topics. - Be the first point of contact and act as interface between Integrity functions to address project related integrity Qualifications - Strong expertise in contractual terms, frame agreements, and global risk review policies, with the ability to assess and mitigate contractual and operational risks. - Solid understanding of project management, project execution models, and financial implications (FCM) throughout the project lifecycle. - Proven experience in regulatory compliance, legal frameworks, and the application of both Common and Civil Law in commercial contexts. - Skilled in negotiation and claim management, ensuring effective resolution of commercial issues and protection of business interests. - Knowledge of business strategy, sales processes, account management practices, and engineering project sales channels. - Familiarity with relevant product portfolios and the capability to translate technical offerings into commercially sound contract structures. descriptionByLocale.it: ## Descrizione At ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a superare - più sottili e pulite. Qui, il progresso è un'aspettativa - per te, il tuo team e il mondo. Come leader di mercato globale, ti daremo ciò di cui hai bisogno per farlo accadere. Non sarà sempre facile, crescere richiede coraggio. Ma ad ABB, non correrai mai da solo. Corri ciò che fa funzionare il mondo. This Position reports to: Quality Manager ## Ruoli e Responsabilità Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità Come Senior Quality Specialist, supporterai la deploy dei Quality strategy, compresa la cultura, i sistemi e le strumentazioni per raggiungere e superare le aspettative dei clienti, assicurando operazioni sostenibili. - Aiuterai l'organizzazione a raggiungere la giusta miscela di prevenzione, miglioramento continuo, analisi di causa radicale robusta, risposta rapida e soluzioni sostenibili ai problemi. - Collaborerai con le funzioni locali che influiscono sui risultati di qualità per raggiungere gli obiettivi per l'unità organizzativa e mirare a un livello di prestazione di classe mondiale. ## Mansioni Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è ibrido. Questa posizione contribuisce alla divisione Critical Power, Smart Power a Quartino, Svizzera. Sarai principalmente responsabile per: - Assicurare una revisione efficace e efficiente del sistema di gestione della qualità dell'unità locale in collaborazione stretta con le funzioni locali, compresi i processi e le strumentazioni per assicurare un'introduzione di prodotto, la produzione e la consegna di qualità, servizi o esecuzione di progetti, e l'identificazione di lacune e potenziale miglioramento. - Utilizzare il sistema di gestione della qualità locale per fornire ai team locali procedure e documentazione che descrivano a sufficienza le loro attività di lavoro. - Condurre l'esecuzione di audit di conformità/revisioni, preparare rapporti di audit che riassumono le scoperte, i rischi e le raccomandazioni, e comunicare i risultati alla gestione auditata. - Collaborare con il team di sourcing per l'assegnazione e la qualificazione di nuovi fornitori, eseguire audit di fornitori e seguire le azioni. - Monitorare gli indicatori di prestazione di qualità (PPM-FPY-DPU-COQ). - Stabilire un approccio strutturato per migliorare la qualità dei fornitori mediante il concetto di Quality Wins nel'organizzazione dei fornitori e l'implementazione del PPAP sito del fornitore e mantenerlo aggiornato. ## Requisiti Qualifiche per il ruolo - Laurea magistrale in Elettronica, Meccanica o Ingegneria del Management. - 5+ anni di esperienza professionale in un ruolo simile. - Profonda conoscenza dello standard ISO 9001. - Esperienza nel lavoro con metodologie analitiche basate su dati per la qualità industriale e con clienti esigenti. - Approccio forte al miglioramento continuo e alla risoluzione dei problemi. - Buone abilità di comunicazione (scritto e orale) in italiano/inglese. ## Cosa offriamo Ti unirai a un team dinamico, talentuoso e di alto rendimento, dove potrai prosperare. ## Contatto Di più su di noi ABB Smart Power è un leader tecnologico globale, con prodotti e soluzioni che rendono le forniture di energia intelligenti, connesse e protette. I suoi prodotti e soluzioni intelligenti rendono le forniture di energia più competitive migliorando l'efficienza energetica, la produttività e la affidabilità di quasi qualsiasi operazione. Noi valorizziamo le persone da diversi background. Potrebbe essere la tua storia? Candidati oggi o visita www.abb.com per leggere di più su di noi e imparare sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.
